He said that upon straightening, he initially intended to improve to the inside of Emperor however then altered course to the outside of that horse when it shifted in approaching the 300m. He further added that with his mount still laying out he persisted for a run between Emperor and King of Sparta but was unable to place Verdoux under full pressure anticipating that the run would tighten which ultimately occurred near the 100m. He said that Verdoux remained held up and was not able to be fully tested as a result. T. Sherry was advised that his evidence would be noted. - seriously looked like there was a statue aboard - # forget ever ran
